shared_elements: standing elaborately costumed human figure in low relief
loincloth or apron panel with decorative motifs
blocks of glyphic signs in a grid arranged beside the figure
figure holding/cradling a ceremonial object or bundle
feet shown on a basal band or platform
justification: Both show a single richly ornamented standing human figure in low relief, with a huge plumed headdress sweeping to one side, heavy pectoral and beaded ornaments, an apron/loincloth panel over the legs, feet on a basal register, and columns of square glyph blocks filling the field beside the figure — an unusually specific combined scheme. The main differences are orientation and framing details (A shows the figure in near-profile with an emerging secondary figure/ancestor at the left and glyph columns on both sides, while B's figure is more frontal with the glyph panel confined to one side), which are variations within the same evident iconographic tradition.
